WITH date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
customer_attributes AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name
    FROM customer
),
channel_rows AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date, 1 AS channel_source
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_attributes c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date, 2 AS channel_source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_attributes c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date, 3 AS channel_source
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_attributes c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
hot_cust AS (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM channel_rows
    GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT channel_source) = 3
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hot_cust LIMIT 100
